g.text: An unsteady tank stores the difference between inflow and outflow

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Incompressible constant-density fluid; t in seconds and V in litres. Starting at V₀=100 L gives 160 L after 60 s, while the tank has capacity. For
species, d(VC_A)/dt=Q_in C_in−Q_out C_A+generation; varying V must remain inside the derivative.
